ad.audience: Women in Seoul and across Korea who shop for delicate gold gifts for loved ones.
ad.creative: Put money behind top on-hand Reels that show rings in morning light. Shoppers save wearing clips to picture size and shine before they choose a gift.

creator_brief.ask: Share a calm on-hand clip in soft morning light wearing the ring with coffee or linen.

creator_brief.who: Small creators with calm everyday style. They wear thin gold jewelry at home and in cafes and share soft daylight clips.
